nodes.summary: A finite sequence $w_1 w_2 \cdots w_n$ of natural numbers is an ascent sequence when $w_1 = 0$ (if $n \ge 1$) and $w_i \le \operatorname{asc}(w_1 \cdots w_{i-1}) + 1$ for every $1 \le i \le n$, where $\operatorname{asc}(v)$ counts the positions $j$ with $v_j < v_{j+1}$. In particular the empty sequence is an ascent sequence.

Then $(\Delta^{2j+1} S)(n) = 1$ for every natural number $n$, where $\Delta$ is the forward difference $(\Delta a)(n) = a(n+1) - a(n)$.

nodes.summary: For integers $n$ and $k$ with $n \ge 2$ and $0 < k < n$, the Rascal numbers $R_{n,k}$ satisfy $R_{n,k} = R_{n-1,k} + R_{n-1,k-1} - R_{n-2,k-1} + 1$.
nodes.title: Fleron's recurrence for Rascal numbers

nodes.summary: For integers $n$, $k$, $\ell$, $u$ with $\ell \ge 0$, $u \ge 0$ and $\ell \le k \le n - u$, the Rascal numbers satisfy $R_{n,k} R_{n-u-\ell,k-\ell} = R_{n-u,k} R_{n-\ell,k-\ell} + u\ell$.
nodes.title: Generalized diamond recurrence for Rascal numbers

nodes.summary: For integers $n$ and $k$ with $0 \le k \le n$, the Rascal numbers satisfy $R_{n,k} = R_{n,n-k}$.
nodes.title: Symmetry of Rascal numbers

nodes.summary: For integers $n$ and $k$, the Rascal number $R_{n,k}$ is $k(n-k) + 1$ if $0 \le k \le n$, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Rascal numbers on the integers

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$, $k$ and $r$ with $k \le n$ and $r \ge 2$, the Rascal numbers satisfy $\sum_{j=0}^{r} (-1)^{r-j} \binom{r}{j} R_{n+j,k} = 0$.
nodes.title: Vanishing higher finite differences of Rascal numbers

nodes.summary: Write $R^{(j)}_{n,k}$ for the number of binary words of length $n$ with exactly $k$ ones and at most $j$ ascents (positions where a $0$ is immediately followed by a $1$). For natural numbers $j$ and $m$ with $m \ge 1$, $\sum_{k=0}^{2m} (-1)^k R^{(j)}_{2m,k} = (-1)^j \binom{m-1}{j}$, and for $m = 0$ the sum equals $1$.
nodes.title: Alternating row sums of generalized Rascal numbers on even rows

nodes.summary: Write $R^{(j)}_{n,k}$ for the number of binary words of length $n$ with exactly $k$ ones and at most $j$ ascents (positions where a $0$ is immediately followed by a $1$). For all natural numbers $j$ and $m$, $\sum_{k=0}^{2m+1} (-1)^k R^{(j)}_{2m+1,k} = 0$.
nodes.title: Alternating row sums of generalized Rascal numbers vanish on odd rows

nodes.summary: Write $R^{(j)}_{n,k}$ for the number of binary words of length $n$ with exactly $k$ ones and at most $j$ ascents (positions where a $0$ is immediately followed by a $1$). For every natural number $j$, $\sum_{k=0}^{4j+3} R^{(j)}_{4j+3,k} = 2^{4j+2}$.
nodes.title: A power-of-two row sum of generalized Rascal numbers

nodes.summary: Write $R^{(j)}_{n,k}$ for the number of binary words of length $n$ with exactly $k$ ones and at most $j$ ascents (positions where a $0$ is immediately followed by a $1$). For all natural numbers $j$ and $n$, $\sum_{k=0}^{n} R^{(j)}_{n,k} = \sum_{k=0}^{2j+1} \binom{n}{k}$, where $\binom{n}{k} = 0$ for $k > n$.
nodes.title: Row sums of generalized Rascal numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the Rascal numbers satisfy $\sum_{k=0}^{2m} (-1)^k R_{2m,k} = 1 - m$.
nodes.title: Alternating row sums of Rascal numbers on even rows

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the Rascal numbers $R_{n,k} = k(n-k) + 1$ ($0 \le k \le n$) satisfy $\sum_{k=0}^{2m+1} (-1)^k R_{2m+1,k} = 0$.
nodes.title: Alternating row sums of the Rascal triangle, odd rows

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $k$ and $r$, the Rascal numbers $R_{n,k} = k(n-k) + 1$ ($0 \le k \le n$) satisfy $\sum_{i=0}^{r} R_{k+i,k} = k \binom{r+1}{2} + r + 1$.
nodes.title: Column sums of the Rascal triangle

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the Rascal numbers $R_{n,k} = k(n-k) + 1$ ($0 \le k \le n$) satisfy $\sum_{k=0}^{n} R_{n,k} = \binom{n+1}{3} + n + 1$.
nodes.title: Row sums of the Rascal triangle

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 2$, the Rascal numbers $R_{i,j} = j(i-j) + 1$ ($0 \le j \le i$) satisfy $\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sum_{j=1}^{i-1} R_{i,j} = \binom{n+2}{4} + \binom{n}{2}$.
nodes.title: Sum of the interior Rascal numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the Rascal numbers $R_{n,k} = k(n-k) + 1$ ($0 \le k \le n$) satisfy $2 \sum_{k=0}^{n} \binom{n}{k} R_{n,k} = 2^n \binom{n}{2} + 2^{n+1}$.
nodes.title: Binomial-weighted row sums of the Rascal triangle

nodes.summary: For a finite word $w = w_1 w_2 \cdots w_n$ of natural numbers, the number of ascents of $w$ is the number of indices $i$ with $1 \le i < n$ and $w_i < w_{i+1}$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
